pass.answer: Unexpanded or empty means the default, true.
A value still showing its user_config token, or blank, reads as the default true.
If it arrives empty or as the raw token, check treats the toggle as on, which is the default.

fail.answer: An unexpanded value is a FAIL: the option is not configured.
fail.why: near miss: a defect, not the default

fail.answer: Unexpanded means default true; empty means off.
Check reports whatever is in settings.
